claims.quote: `bun run affected` says which test files, checks, and mutations the changes since a commit can reach, picked by Lion rules from a map of what each test file reached when it last ran, and `--run` runs them
`bun run affected --map` runs every package's tests once with a setup file that records the source files whose functions each test file ran, the files it read, and whether it ran git
`bun run affected --check` treats each listed mutation as a change to its file, and lists every test the mutation names that picking would skip

says.statement: For every listed mutation, the checks picked for its change catch it whenever the full suite does

claims.quote: `bun run mutate --affected` checks only the mutations the changes since HEAD can reach: those in a changed file, and those whose tests a changed file reaches
`bun run affected --replay 30` says what picking would have run for each of the last 30 commits, beside everything
